title: Payment-Channel Add-On to the LandlordGuard Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Schedule.** The payment-channel add-on of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy returned-payment fee looks at the method of the most recent payment received on the policy, the payment the return reverses: a check adds 5.00 USD; an EFT draft adds 2.50 USD; any other method adds nothing.

The add-on is added in the returned-fee adjustment.

| Method of the most recent payment received on the policy | Payment-channel add-on |
|---|---|
| check | 5.00 USD |
| EFT | 2.50 USD |
| card, a mortgagee's check, or any other method | nothing |

The method is the one recorded on the latest payment received entry on this policy's premium account.

## Hypothetical cases

- The latest payment was a personal check that came back unpaid: 5.00 USD added.
- The latest payment was drawn by EFT: 2.50 USD added.
- The latest payment was made by card: nothing added.
